coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

record.name: Community Center Garage (UCSF Mission Bay)

notes.accuracy_caveat: PARTIALLY REAL -- UCSF's June 2025 CAC map (updated December 2024) labels this 'COMMUNITY CENTER GARAGE (21A)' with a parking symbol and does not list it among the undeveloped parcels, which supports an existing garage here; the rooftop deck and painted parking-space striping are Pier & Point's own reading of satellite imagery (not cited or saved here), and this record's own boundary was traced as the leftover open ground between DataSF's official street lines and neighbouring mapped shapes, as seen in satellite imagery, not a surveyed building footprint or parcel line; DataSF's own Building Footprints dataset does not separate this garage from the Rutter Center building (both fall under one continuous footprint, mblr SF8709011), so there is no official boundary between 21A and 21B -- the dividing line used here is the Rutter Center's own real west wall, extended, which is a reasonable but not authoritative choice.
notes.digitized_from: Traced as the leftover open ground between DataSF's official street lines and neighbouring mapped shapes in the Owens St / Rutter Center area, as seen in satellite imagery; several pieces were chosen and combined by hand, not taken from a surveyed parcel. First added on 2026-09-20 as part of the neighboring Rutter Community Center record and split out into this separate record on 2026-09-22.

changes.text: The garage record said a real rooftop deck with painted striping was visible in satellite imagery, that it stood beside the William J. Rutter Community Center and was joined by a walkway, and that the area was the 1625 Owens St parking lot. UCSF's June 2025 CAC map supports only an existing garage labeled 'Community Center Garage (21A)' beside 'Rutter Center (21B)'. The record now says so, marks the rooftop deck, walkway and striping as Pier & Point's own satellite reading (not cited), drops the full Rutter Center name, and flags that the 1625 Owens St address is unsourced.
changes.source: UCSF, Mission Bay Development Overview, Mission Bay CAC presentation, 2025-06-12 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/2025-06/Item%202%20-%20UCSF%20Mission%20Bay%20Development%20Overview.pdf)

sources.title: UCSF, Mission Bay Development Overview, Mission Bay CAC presentation, 2025-06-12 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/2025-06/Item%202%20-%20UCSF%20Mission%20Bay%20Development%20Overview.pdf)

record.notes: A parking garage labeled 'COMMUNITY CENTER GARAGE (21A)' on UCSF's own Dec 2024-updated campus map (June 2025 CAC presentation, page 3), immediately west of the block that map labels 'RUTTER CENTER (21B)'. That it has a rooftop deck and is connected to the Rutter Center by a walkway is Pier & Point's own reading of satellite imagery, not stated on UCSF's map, and the building's full name and operator are not confirmed by a primary source.
